operations.name: Add legal hold custodians
operations.description: Names users on a hold, by email or by Granola user id. Idempotent: the response carries the request's full resolved set, whether each entry was newly added or already present.

custodians.description: Users to name on this hold

operations.name: Create legal hold
operations.description: Places a named legal hold on custodians in your workspace. Granola preserves a custodian's notes, transcripts and attachments while any hold covering them is active. Custodians see no change in the product.

name.description: A name for the matter this hold preserves

covers_entire_workspace.description: Whether the hold covers every member of your workspace, current and future. Required: scope is never something a caller falls into.

custodians.description: Users to name individually when the hold is created

operations.name: Create webhook endpoint
operations.description: Registers an HTTPS URL to receive event deliveries. With a Workspace API key the endpoint is workspace-managed: pass `scopes: ["workspace"]`. Delivery follows that key's space limits, and `folder_ids` may only reference folders the key can list.

url.description: The publicly reachable HTTPS URL to deliver events to

scopes.description: Which notes to receive events for. `personal` covers notes you own, notes shared directly with you, and notes in private folders shared with you. `public` covers notes visible to everyone in the workspace. Pass both for both sets of notes. Workspace admins can disable scopes for non-admin members in the workspace's API settings. With a Workspace API key, pass exactly `["workspace"]`; the endpoint

events.description: Event names to subscribe to. Omit to subscribe to all events.

folder_ids.description: Restrict delivery to notes in these folders or any of their subfolders. Accepts folder IDs returned by `GET /v1/folders`, in any casing. Omit to receive events for every note matching `scopes`. With a Workspace API key, folders must also be within that key's space limits. The same filter applies to all subscribed `events`.

operations.name: Delete webhook endpoint
operations.description: Deletes a webhook endpoint. Granola stops sending it events. A space-limited Workspace API key can only delete endpoints created with that exact key. An unrestricted Workspace API key can delete endpoints created by other keys in the same workspace.

webhook_endpoint_id.description: The ID of the webhook endpoint. Case-insensitive.

operations.name: Get legal hold
operations.description: Returns one legal hold. A released hold is still returned, carrying `released_at`.

operations.name: Get note
operations.description: Returns one note with its summary, attendees, calendar event and folders. Pass `include=transcript` to add the transcript. A note the key cannot read, or one without a generated summary, returns `NOTE_NOT_FOUND`.

include.description: Include the note transcript in the response. If a workspace admin has turned off transcript access over the API, `transcript` is null. If it is too large to return inline, Get Note returns `TRANSCRIPT_TOO_LARGE`; retrieve it in pages from `/v1/notes/{note_id}/transcript`.

operations.name: Get transcript
operations.description: Retrieve a meeting transcript in pages, including when Get Note returns `TRANSCRIPT_TOO_LARGE`. Pass `from_time` to start partway through, for example at an excerpt from Search transcripts.

cursor.description: The opaque cursor returned by the previous page

from_time.description: Start at the first transcript item that ends after this UTC timestamp, skipping everything earlier. Pass a passage's `start_time` from Search transcripts to read the conversation from that point. It only sets where the first page starts: it is ignored when `cursor` is set, so it is safe to send on every page. A recording transcribed in one piece that Granola has no timings for is returned from the

page_size.description: The maximum number of transcript items to return

operations.name: List audit events
operations.description: Lists your workspace's audit events, newest first. Requires an Audit API key.

action.description: Return only events with this exact action, or events whose action starts with it followed by a dot (`workspace` returns `workspace.member_added` but not `workspace_automation.created`). Lowercase, as actions are.

occurred_before.description: Return events that occurred before this date. Must fall within the one-year retention window; an earlier date is rejected.

occurred_after.description: Return events that occurred after this date. Must fall within the one-year retention window; an earlier date is rejected.

page_size.description: Maximum number of audit events to return per page

operations.name: List folders
operations.description: Lists the folders the API key can read, ordered by name.

page_size.description: Maximum number of folders to return per page

operations.name: List legal hold custodians
operations.description: Lists the users a hold names, oldest first. Removed custodians are returned alongside active ones, each carrying `removed_at`.

page_size.description: Maximum number of custodians to return per page

operations.name: List legal holds
operations.description: Lists every legal hold in your workspace, newest first. Released holds are returned alongside active ones, each carrying `released_at`.

page_size.description: Maximum number of legal holds to return per page

operations.name: List notes
operations.description: Lists the notes the API key can read, newest first by creation time. Only notes with a generated summary are returned.

created_before.description: Return notes created before this date

created_after.description: Return notes created after this date

updated_after.description: Return notes updated after this date

folder_id.description: Return notes in this folder and any of its child folders. Folder IDs are case-insensitive. Use the list folders endpoint to discover folder IDs.

page_size.description: Maximum number of notes to return per page

space_id.description: Return notes in this space. Space IDs are case-insensitive. Use the list spaces endpoint to discover space IDs.

operations.name: List spaces
operations.description: Lists the spaces the API key can access, ordered by name.

page_size.description: The number of spaces to return

operations.name: List webhook endpoints
operations.description: Lists the webhook endpoints the API key can manage, oldest first. A Workspace API key limited to selected spaces only lists endpoints created with that exact key. An unrestricted Workspace API key can also list endpoints created by other keys in the same workspace.

operations.name: Release legal hold
operations.description: Releases a hold. Release is terminal: the hold is never deleted, there is no un-release, and a matter that reopens is a new hold. Releasing an already-released hold returns its original `released_at`.

operations.name: Remove legal hold custodian
operations.description: Removes a custodian from a hold. The record of who was held survives: the entry is returned by the list endpoint with `removed_at` set. A custodian id that was never issued returns 404.

operations.name: Search notes
operations.description: Search notes by keyword in their titles and summaries, or filter them by participant, folder, space or date. Private notes and transcripts are not searched. Recent notes can be missing until their summary is generated; use List notes for a complete listing. Keys with the Notes by ID scope get no results.

keywords.description: Words to search for in titles and summaries. An entry matches when all its words appear in the title or in the summary, in any order; a note needs only one entry to match.

participant.description: Only meetings with this person or company on the calendar invite: a name, email, company or domain. It does not match names mentioned in the notes.

folder_id.description: Only notes in this folder and its child folders. Use List folders to find folder IDs.

space_id.description: Only notes in this space and its folders. Use List spaces to find space IDs. Combines with folder_id.

from_date.description: Only meetings that started at or after this date or UTC timestamp. A date means midnight UTC. Notes without a calendar event use their creation time.

to_date.description: Only meetings that started at or before this date or UTC timestamp. A date means midnight UTC at the start of that day, so it leaves out meetings later that day.

updated_after.description: Only notes whose content or summary changed after this date or UTC timestamp. A date means midnight UTC.

page_size.description: Maximum number of notes to return per page

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous response, to fetch the next page. Send it alone or with page_size. Cursors expire after 15 minutes.

operations.name: Search transcripts
operations.description: Search meeting transcripts by keyword to find where something was said. Each result is a note with up to two short excerpts from its transcript; pass an excerpt's start_time to Get transcript as from_time to read the conversation from there. Recent meetings can be missing until their note's summary is generated. Keys with the Notes by ID scope get no results.

keywords.description: Words to search for. Required unless cursor is set. An entry matches when all its words are said close together, in any order; a note needs only one entry to match. Synonyms and other spellings are not matched, so add them as separate entries.

note_ids.description: Only search these notes. An ID is ignored when no note has it or the API key cannot read that note.

participant.description: Only meetings with this person or company on the calendar invite, or where they are named as a speaker: a name, email, company or domain. A meeting matched only by speaker name returns just the parts where they spoke.

from_date.description: Only meetings that started at or after this date or UTC timestamp. A date means midnight UTC. Notes without a calendar event use their creation time.

to_date.description: Only meetings that started at or before this date or UTC timestamp. A date means midnight UTC at the start of that day, so it leaves out meetings later that day.

page_size.description: Maximum number of notes to return per page

cursor.description: The cursor from the previous response, to fetch the next page. Send it alone or with page_size. Cursors expire after 15 minutes.

operations.name: Update legal hold
operations.description: Renames or re-describes a hold, or widens and narrows its workspace-wide coverage. Toggling coverage never touches the custodians the hold names. A released hold cannot be updated.

name.description: A new name for the matter

description.description: New free text for the matter, or null to clear it

covers_entire_workspace.description: Whether the hold covers every member of your workspace. Toggling this never touches the custodians the hold names.

operations.name: Update webhook endpoint
operations.description: Changes an endpoint's URL, scopes, events, folder filter or enabled state. Fields you leave out stay as they are. A space-limited Workspace API key can only update endpoints created with that exact key. A workspace-managed endpoint keeps its creating key's space limits, regardless of which authorized key edits it.

webhook_endpoint_id.description: The ID of the webhook endpoint. Case-insensitive.

url.description: The publicly reachable HTTPS URL to deliver events to. Omit to leave unchanged.

events.description: Event names to subscribe to; replaces the current subscriptions. Omit to leave unchanged.

folder_ids.description: Restrict delivery to notes in these folders or any of their subfolders; replaces the current folder filter. Accepts folder IDs returned by `GET /v1/folders`, in any casing. For a workspace-managed endpoint, folders must be within the creating key's space limits, even when another key edits the endpoint. Pass an empty array to remove the folder filter; the key's space limits still apply. Omit to le
